title: EvidenceItem
description: The atomic unit of the system. Every number that appears anywhere downstream MUST trace back to one of these. Analyst agents may read these but never create them.

metric.description: Canonical metric key, e.g. revenue_ttm, fcf_ttm, shares_diluted, book_value_per_share

fiscal_period.description: REQUIRED. e.g. FY2025, Q3-FY2026, TTM-2026-06-30. Never omit; a number without a period is unusable.

source_type.description: Primary sources rank above aggregators. Verifier downgrades confidence for aggregator-only figures on the current-quarter story.

note.description: e.g. 'aggregator lags one quarter behind the 2026-07-30 release'
